messages.text:
At 16¢ the 40T runs about $75 a month in power, on a $799 machine. It's a real block draw every ten minutes, all year, and you keep the machine either way.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

Good first one. The 40T is our best value per TH — 40 TH/s for $799, 650 W, about $75 a month at your rate, and it runs Harlo OS so you can mine solo for the block shot or point it at a pool and stack sats to your own wallet.

Where would it sit — desk or garage?

Basement is ideal — fan noise and 650 W of heat don't bother anyone down there, and in winter it's heat you'd have paid for anyway.

The 40T is the one I'd get: Ships November 21, 2026, Batch 6. Want me to put it in a cart?
is this better than harlo h15?
Read the bsb b30 dual page

The H15 Dual isn't buyable yet — it's a coming-soon drop with no announced date, so there's nothing to check out today.

The 40T you're looking at is here now at $799, Ships November 21, 2026. Want me to build the cart?
need to know which is better

Different jobs. The 40T is a straight Bitcoin miner — 40 TH/s from a BM1370, best value per TH we sell, and that's where the block draw is. The H15 Dual is $999 and splits across Bitcoin and Dogecoin, so you're paying more for breadth, not more Bitcoin hashrate.

First miner, Bitcoin-focused? The 40T wins. Cart it?
